## TreeInput type

Plain creation input or class tree accepted by [Tree.from()](./midnight-sdk.tree.from.md)<!-- -->.

Use this only at boundaries that intentionally convert caller input into a `Tree`<!-- -->. Ratifier helpers accept [RatifierTreeInput](./midnight-sdk.ratifiertreeinput.md) instead, so they can reuse an existing `Tree` or normalize raw offer/group input.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type TreeInput = Tree | TreeCreateParams | GroupInput;
```
**References:** [Tree](./midnight-sdk.tree.md)<!-- -->, [TreeCreateParams](./midnight-sdk.treecreateparams.md)<!-- -->, [GroupInput](./midnight-sdk.groupinput.md)

## Example


```ts
import { Offer, type TreeInput } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";
import { zeroAddress } from "viem";

const offer = Offer.create({
  market: {
    chainId: 8453,
    midnight: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001000",
    loanToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000006000",
    collateralParams: [
      {
        token: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000007000",
        lltv: 770000000000000000n,
        liquidationCursor: 250000000000000000n,
        oracle: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000008000",
      },
    ],
    maturity: 54_000n,
    rcfThreshold: 0n,
    enterGate: zeroAddress,
    liquidatorGate: zeroAddress,
  },
  buy: true,
  maker: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000009000",
  tick: 5_000n,
  expiry: 3_600n,
  ratifier: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000004000",
  maxUnits: 100n,
});
const tree: TreeInput = [offer];
console.log(tree);
```
